user_snapshot: Philosophy grad in Kano, fresh off NYSC, no savings, no income, living with parents. Writing and research are real assets; the problem is zero runway and a family watching.
headline_insight: Your ₦0 savings plus low risk tolerance rules out bootcamps and JAPA right now — but your Philosophy degree plus writing/research/public-speaking stack is exactly what remote content and NGO work in the North pays for, and both can start paying within 60 days from Kano.

routes.title: NGO Program Assistant → Program Officer (Northern Humanitarian Corridor)
routes.one_liner: Enter the INGO ecosystem in Kano/Maiduguri/Abuja as a program assistant, move to officer within 18 months.

fit_reasons.note: Kano is the Northern humanitarian hub — Mercy Corps, IRC, MSF, Save the Children all have field offices hiring locally.
Your writing + research + public speaking stack is exactly what program assistants do daily: reports, M&E, community sessions.

break_reasons.risk: Entry roles often require 1-2 years' volunteer or intern experience; you may need 3-6 months of unpaid INGO volunteering to break in.

routes.who_this_fits: Grads who can write clean English reports, sit through long field days, and tolerate 6-month contract cycles.
routes.who_this_breaks: People who need instant ₦150k+ or refuse volunteer work as a bridge.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: 2-3 months of unpaid or stipend-only volunteering before a paid contract. Transport money within Kano.

real_pay.range_note: INGO contracts in Kano/Borno pay higher than local NGOs. UN agencies (UNICEF, IOM) pay top of range.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, you're a Program Officer at Mercy Corps or IRC Kano field office, earning ₦400-500k/mo, managing a small grant portfolio, with ₦2m+ saved and a clear path to UN consultancy or a funded Masters abroad.
pro_tips: Apply in Hausa-speaking cohorts — huge edge in Northern field roles.
Cold-email the M&E officer, not HR; decisions happen at unit level.

job_sites.name: NGO Career Centre
job_sites.why: Primary Nigerian NGO board — Mercy Corps and IRC post Kano field roles here first.

job_sites.name: ReliefWeb Jobs
job_sites.why: Global humanitarian portal — UN agencies and INGOs post Northern Nigeria roles weekly.

job_sites.name: MyJobMag
job_sites.why: Local NGO openings filterable by Kano — good for smaller NGOs as entry point.

monday_actions.step: Email 5 INGO field offices in Kano (Mercy Corps, IRC, Save the Children, NRC, Plan Int'l) offering volunteer research support.
Sign up for Kaya Connect free humanitarian courses (Sphere Standards, Protection) — completion certs boost CV.
Create a ReliefWeb profile and set Kano + Nigeria alerts for Program Assistant/Officer roles.

milestones: Volunteer attachment with 1 INGO or local partner

routes.nigerian_notes: The Kano-Maiduguri humanitarian corridor is one of the few places in Nigeria where Philosophy/Arts grads out-earn Engineering grads. Hausa fluency is a major asset. Security clearance required for Borno field deployment.

routes.title: Remote Content Writer → Content Strategist (USD)
routes.one_liner: Build a writing portfolio on Contra/Upwork, land recurring USD clients, scale to $1,500-3,000/mo within 18 months.

fit_reasons.note: Writing and research are the two core skills that pay immediately on Contra and Upwork — no retraining needed.
Remote-native work from Kano is viable; power and internet on a Spectranet/MTN 5G router is enough.

break_reasons.risk: Zero savings + 3-6 month runway to first real client is brutal. Most quit in month 2 when no response comes.

routes.who_this_fits: Writers who can grind 20 cold pitches a week for 4 months without quitting, and who treat it as a sales job.
routes.who_this_breaks: People waiting for clients to find them, or who need ₦100k in month one.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings and weekends for 6 months pitching with no income. Data subscriptions ~₦15k/mo.

real_pay.range_note: Paid in USD ($200-3500/mo). NGN figures at ₦1500/$. Specializing in B2B SaaS or fintech content doubles rates.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, you're billing $2,000-2,500/mo as a B2B SaaS content writer for 2-3 retainer clients, working from Kano, earning ~₦3m/mo in NGN terms, with USD savings and a Chancenkarte application in motion.
pro_tips: Pick one niche (fintech, health, SaaS) by month 2 — generalists starve.
Publish 2 samples weekly on Medium; clients check before hiring.

job_sites.name: Contra
job_sites.why: No-fee freelance platform where content writers land $500-2000 retainers faster than Upwork.

job_sites.name: Upwork
job_sites.why: Largest pool but competitive — start with sub-$20/hr gigs to build reviews, then raise rates.

job_sites.name: Superpath
job_sites.why: Content-marketing-only job board — B2B SaaS clients paying $50-100/hr post here.

monday_actions.step: Write 3 sample articles (800-1200 words) in one niche — fintech, productivity, or health — and publish on Medium.
Build Contra profile + LinkedIn 'open to work' with 'Content Writer' headline and link samples.
Join Superpath Slack and Peak Freelance community — both have job channels refreshed daily.

routes.nigerian_notes: Get a Payoneer + Grey + domiciliary account setup early — PayPal still limits Nigeria-to-client flows. Kano power is unreliable; budget ₦40k for a small inverter by month 3.

routes.title: International School Teacher → Abroad Teaching License
routes.one_liner: Land a humanities teaching role at a Kano international school, earn PGCE online, route to UAE/UK teaching within 2-3 years.

fit_reasons.note: Public speaking + research + writing is exactly what humanities teachers use; Philosophy maps to Government, Civic, Literature.
Kano has growing international schools (Essence, Graceland, American International) hiring humanities graduates.

break_reasons.risk: Top Kano international schools prefer PGDE/Education-trained candidates; you'll compete against Ed grads for the same slot.

routes.who_this_fits: Patient communicators who enjoy working with teenagers and can study for PGDE part-time.
routes.who_this_breaks: Introverts, or people who want a hard exit from Nigeria within 12 months.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Part-time PGDE fees (NTI ₦180-250k) across 12-18 months. Weekends for teaching prep.

real_pay.range_note: Kano international schools pay less than Lagos (top Lagos ₦400-700k). UAE teaching pays ₦1.5-3m equivalent tax-free.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, you're teaching Literature or Government at a Kano international school earning ₦220-280k/mo, halfway through NTI PGDE, with a TEFL cert and applications going to UAE international schools paying ₦1.8m+ tax-free.
pro_tips: Target IGCSE/Cambridge schools — their teachers transition abroad easiest.
Offer a free demo lesson — 80% of hiring decisions happen there.

job_sites.name: MyJobMag Education
job_sites.why: Kano international schools post humanities teaching vacancies here regularly.

job_sites.name: Teach Away
job_sites.why: UAE/Qatar/China teaching placements — pathway site once you have 1-2 years' experience.

job_sites.name: TES Jobs
job_sites.why: UK and international school board — for the 2-year exit stage to UK/UAE/Saudi.

monday_actions.step: Visit 3 Kano international schools physically (Essence, Graceland, American International) with CV and one-page teaching philosophy.
Sign up for a ₦30k online TEFL/TESOL cert (Premier TEFL or International TEFL Academy) — finish in 4 weeks.
Research NTI PGDE intake dates (nti.edu.ng) and budget the first-semester fee.

milestones: Teach Away / Search Associates profile live

routes.nigerian_notes: NTI (National Teachers Institute) PGDE is the cheapest recognised route; Kano has a study centre. UAE schools start recruiting Nigerian teachers in December-February for September intake.

routes.title: Legal/Policy Research Virtual Assistant → Policy Analyst
routes.one_liner: Use Philosophy's research/argumentation strength to do remote legal research, think-tank support, or academic VA work for US/UK firms.

fit_reasons.note: Philosophy is built for legal reasoning, policy analysis, and argument synthesis — niche but well-paid in research VA roles.
Research + writing combination is exactly what solo US attorneys and think-tank associates outsource for $15-40/hr.

break_reasons.risk: Niche and slow to find — may take 4-6 months of pitching to land first client, and zero savings makes the wait punishing.

routes.who_this_fits: Detail-obsessed readers who enjoy long-form research and can tolerate slow client acquisition.
routes.who_this_breaks: People who need visible wins monthly or who hate writing 3000-word memos.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Data + Coursera Legal Research cert + 6 months of pitching with no guarantees.

real_pay.range_note: Paid in USD ($200-1500/mo). Policy research for African think tanks (CSEA, NESG) pays in NGN at ₦150-400k.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, you're a research associate at CSEA or a remote policy VA for a US nonprofit earning ₦500-700k/mo, with two published policy briefs under your name and a shortlist for Chevening/Mandela Washington Fellowship.
pro_tips: Pitch solo US immigration attorneys — understaffed, pay $20-30/hr.
Publish on SSRN or Medium to prove research chops publicly.

job_sites.name: Upwork Legal Category
job_sites.why: US solo attorneys post legal research gigs $15-40/hr — Philosophy grads compete well.

job_sites.name: Idealist
job_sites.why: Policy/research associate roles at US and UK nonprofits — many allow remote Africa-based hires.

job_sites.name: NESG Careers
job_sites.why: Lagos-based economic think tank hiring research associates; Philosophy backgrounds welcomed.

monday_actions.step: Write one 1500-word policy brief on a Nigerian issue (e.g. fuel subsidy removal, Kano water crisis) and publish on Medium + LinkedIn.
Create Upwork profile with 'Legal Research' + 'Policy Research' tags, apply to 10 gigs in week one.
Follow and engage with 20 analysts at CSEA, NESG, CDD, Stears on LinkedIn; comment substantively on their posts.

milestones: $500-1000/mo retainer or NGN-paid think tank role

roadmap.focus: Positioning for grad school or senior role

routes.nigerian_notes: This is the slowest route on the list but the one that positions best for Chevening/MasterCard Foundation scholarships — which would solve the JAPA question entirely. Worth pairing as a side-track to the NGO or content-writing route.

routes_filtered_out.route: Law conversion (LL.B second degree + law school)
routes_filtered_out.reason: Requires ₦3-5m over 4-5 years; your ₦0 savings and low risk tolerance make this impossible without a funded scholarship first.

routes_filtered_out.route: Tech bootcamp (AltSchool, Decagon, ALX) → Remote dev
routes_filtered_out.reason: ₦500k-1m upfront plus 12-18 months unpaid — incompatible with ₦0 savings, 12-month horizon, and low risk tolerance. Junior dev market also saturated in 2026.
Cheapest realistic route (Germany Chancenkarte with B1) still needs ₦1-2m + 12-18 months of German classes. Revisit once NGO or remote writing route puts ₦1.5m+ in savings.
Pay entry ₦50-100k + travel-heavy — poor fit for your public-speaking strength being better spent in teaching/NGO, and Kano base limits FMCG territory.
